proofs.proof_tex:
Put \(m=|\mathcal A|\) and \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\).  Theorem~\(\mathrm{Explicit\ oracle\ enumeration\ frontier}\) supplies a deterministic algorithm for the uniform certificates accepted by \(\operatorname{Acc}\).  These are exactly the restricted uniform certificates quantified over in the present statement; the word ``restricted'' records that scope and does not change the feasible set.  The cited theorem gives, simultaneously,
\[
 \#\{\text{distinct queries to }\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\}\leq 2^m,
\]
\[
 T,\;S_{\mathrm{oracle}}
 \leq 2^{O(m+L)}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O}),
\]
where \(T\) is running time and \(S_{\mathrm{oracle}}\) is oracle-answer space.  It also states that the returned certificate is the lexicographically first optimum when \(\operatorname{Opt}<+\infty\), whereas a final infinite value certifies \(\operatorname{Opt}=+\infty\).  These are every algorithmic and output clause of the present theorem.  Consequently the positive alternative in the oracle-search question holds for the restricted uniform problem.  Since the invoked theorem asserts only this upper bound, the corollary asserts no oracle lower bound.

proposed.statement:
Let \(m=|\mathcal A|\) and \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\).  Exact minimum-cost optimization over the restricted uniform acquisition certificates \(E\) accepted by \(\operatorname{Acc}\) has a deterministic algorithm that makes at most \(2^m\) distinct queries to \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\), runs in
\[
 2^{O(m+L)}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O}),
\]
and uses
\[
 2^{O(m+L)}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})
\]
oracle-answer space.  It returns the lexicographically first optimum restricted uniform certificate when \(\operatorname{Opt}<+\infty\), and otherwise certifies \(\operatorname{Opt}=+\infty\).  Thus the positive algorithmic alternative in the oracle-search question holds for the explicitly restricted uniform-certificate problem; no oracle lower bound is asserted.

prose_updates.tldr: Generic operational nonfailure of the complete, correctly typed unconditional procedure is equivalent to a branch-indexed switching certificate with one singleton-index record for every concrete branch \(\alpha\in\Omega\): source selection remains inside the branch quantifier, so the result never exchanges \(\forall\alpha\,\exists\) for \(\exists\,\forall\alpha\).  The main acquisition optimum is exactly weighted set cover on the protocol incidence sets \(K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)\).  The complete incidence relation uses at most \(2^{|\mathcal A|}\) source-oracle queries and \(2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|)}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})\) work; exact optimization uses \(2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+\min\{M,2^{|\mathcal A|}\})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})\), and weighted greedy gives an \(H_M\)-approximation after that explicit incidence construction.  The canonical certificate bound includes its exact framing term and \(Mq_M\), not \(M^2\), ownership bits and may be exponential.  Positivity is required only for conditioning events actually used by the operational predicate; no semantic completeness extension for CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) and no semantic nonidentifiability certificate are claimed.  The Akbari--Etesami--Kiyavash comparison is a separate finite full-kernel batch with protocol charges shared across cells, not a scalar-query reduction, and its hardness and logarithmic threshold transfer only under the stated source-oracle convention.  The one-source-per-factor optimizer remains a restricted uniform corollary.

project_justification.fill: The project supplies a certificate-independent charged source interface and proves an exact switching normal form: generic operational nonfailure holds if and only if every concrete branch \(\alpha\in\Omega\) has a successful singleton-index protocol--slice--source record, with the witness for a branch chosen after that branch is fixed.  This gives the exact weighted-set-cover identity \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}=\min_{\mathcal P:\,\cup_{S\in\mathcal P}K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)=\Omega}\sum_{S\in\mathcal P}w(S)\), explicit incidence construction with at most \(2^{|\mathcal A|}\) oracle queries, exact branch-mask or protocol-subset optimization, and an \(H_M\) weighted-greedy guarantee after incidence construction.  A canonical witness has exactly \(M\) nonempty records and a bound with explicit record-count framing and \(Mq_M\) ownership bits, though it may be exponential.  The contribution also includes the fixed-factor obstruction, the positive physical separation, and a separately typed finite full-kernel batch comparison with ordinary intervention design.

prose_updates.related_work: Raghavan and Bareinboim (2025) define SELECT, RAND, CTF-RAND, and READ and give CTF-REALIZE for physical sampling, but not minimum-cost acquisition with a charged source-support interface.  Raghavan and Bareinboim (2026) give complete CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) processing for a fixed source collection.  The switching normal form here preserves its operational quantifier order by allowing the successful source record to depend on the concrete assignment and equality-type branch.  Correa, Lee, and Bareinboim (2021) provide the unnesting and ctf-factorization substrate.  Event-local support checks here require positivity only for conditioning events actually used by a certificate and do not extend semantic CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) completeness.  Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2025) prove their weighted-hitting-set reduction in Theorem~3 and NP-completeness and logarithmic inapproximability in Corollaries~1--2 (printed page~7; the proof of Theorem~3 is on printed pages~31--33).  Our comparison is a separate finite full-kernel batch with shared protocol charges; it is not a reduction to one scalar counterfactual query, and the hardness transfer is relative to the specified oracle representation.  For the general physical problem, exact optimization is the explicit weighted set cover on \(K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)\); weighted greedy gives \(H_M\) only after its potentially exponential incidence relation has been constructed.  The separate \(H_k\) action-cover statement remains confined to the explicit one-action, protocolwise-legality, factorwise-no-synergy subclass.  Park and Lee (2026) provide the downstream counterfactual structural bandit setting rather than an acquisition-cost theorem.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation:
The concrete branch count \(M=|\Omega|\) may be exponential in the structural input.  Accordingly, the canonical bound
\[
 B_{\mathrm{sw}}=2\lfloor\log_2(M+1)\rfloor+1+M\bigl(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+q_M+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)+b_{\tau}\bigr)
\]
has an explicit framing term and exactly \(Mq_M\) branch-ownership bits, but is not a polynomial certificate bound.  Building all protocol incidences can require \(2^{|\mathcal A|}\) oracle queries and exponential work; exact optimization adds the factor \(2^{O(\min\{M,2^{|\mathcal A|}\})}\).  Source-support replies and operational infeasibility certificates may likewise be exponential, with every accessed bit charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\).  The weighted-greedy \(H_M\) ratio is therefore a guarantee after explicit incidence construction, not a polynomial-time global action-cover approximation.  Event-local positivity only licenses denominators for used slice events, and measured ancestry excludes sources that fail to record or action-fix a required transformed ancestor.  Neither condition yields semantic soundness or completeness of CTFIDU\({}^{+}\), and failure of the operational cover is not claimed to certify semantic nonidentifiability.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The primary result is operational: correctly typed generic nonfailure is equivalent to one singleton-index switching witness per \(\alpha\in\Omega\), preserving the order \(\forall\alpha\,\exists\) rather than imposing a uniform \(\exists\,\forall\alpha\) source.  It yields exact weighted set cover on \(K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)\), explicit incidence and exact-optimization bounds, and an \(H_M\) weighted-greedy guarantee only after the full incidence relation is available.  The finite canonical certificate exposes both record-count framing and \(Mq_M\) ownership bits and may be exponential; no polynomial general lower certificate is promised.  Positivity is local to conditioning events used by acceptance, measured ancestry remains mandatory, and no semantic identification-completeness extension or semantic nonidentifiability certificate follows.  The restricted uniform theorem is only an OEQ-facing corollary and is not equivalent to generic acceptance.  The ordinary Akbari--Etesami--Kiyavash comparison concerns a separately defined finite full-kernel batch with charges shared across target cells, not the main scalar query; its NP-hardness and logarithmic threshold transfer only relative to the stated oracle convention.  The \(H_k\) action-cover approximation is confined to the explicit one-action/no-synergy factor-cover subclass.  No scalar identifying-functional output, numerical evaluation theorem, compactness theorem, conditional or arbitrary partial-read completeness, mediator-depth fixed-parameter tractability, bounded-treewidth compiler, or global action-cover approximation is claimed.

added_lemmas.statement: The minimum-weight hitting-set problem reduces in polynomial time to the ordinary minimum-cost intervention problem.  In the cited construction, original vertices retain their hitting-set weights, auxiliary vertices have prohibitive infinite cost, and finite-cost identifying interventions are exactly the hitting sets with the same cost.
